# Hydra Sync 1.9.0

Optional hand-off to HowLongToBeat: when a sync raises a game's playtime, Hydra Sync can now ask the HowLongToBeat extension to submit the new total.

## What's new

**Push playtime to HowLongToBeat** (a new setting, off by default). Once a sync raises a game's playtime, Hydra Sync hands that game to the HowLongToBeat extension and lets it submit the new total — the same call HowLongToBeat makes itself when a game exits. It updates the playtime only, so a background sync doesn't mark the game as "Playing".

- Only games the sync actually raised are pushed. A game whose playtime was left alone is never submitted.
- You get a follow-up notification: `Hydra Sync → HowLongToBeat: updated 3, skipped 1`.
- Games are skipped rather than guessed at: signed-out accounts, games carrying HowLongToBeat's "ignore playtime sync" tag, and games HowLongToBeat has no data for are all passed over.
- At most 25 games per sync, because each push is a couple of network round-trips.
- If the extension isn't installed, you get one notification saying so and nothing else changes.

**Two new game context-menu items** under `Hydra Sync`:

| Item | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Push playtime to HowLongToBeat now** | Submits the selected games' current playtime immediately, whether or not the setting is on. |
| **Diagnose HowLongToBeat playtime sync…** | Reports whether the extension is reachable, whether you're logged in, whether it has data for that game, and whether the game is excluded from playtime sync. |

### How it talks to HowLongToBeat

No reference to HowLongToBeat.dll ships with Hydra Sync. The extension Playnite already loaded is located at runtime and only the playtime call is used; everything else keeps HowLongToBeat's own defaults. If that extension's signature ever changes in a way Hydra Sync can't bind, it disables the automatic push and says so instead of failing a sync.

## Upgrade notes

- **Opt-in.** The setting starts off, so nothing is sent anywhere after upgrading. Turn it on in the extension's settings panel.
- Nothing to re-sync and no stored state changes. Existing playtime and achievement syncing behave exactly as before.

## Install

1. Download `HydraSync-1.9.0.pext` from the [releases page](https://github.com/cometmcisaac/hydra-playnite-sync/releases).
2. Double-click it and confirm the install in Playnite — or extract the package (it's a plain zip) into `%APPDATA%\Playnite\Extensions\A76358E9-BFA2-4189-B6F3-2307EA4E217B\`.
3. Restart Playnite.

Settings live at `Add-ons → Extensions settings → Generic → Hydra Sync`.
